about.descripcion:
PMDL Editor is a modding tool designed
to simplify advanced editing of PMDL files,
the 3D model format used in Dragon Ball Z:
Tenkaichi Tag Team.

This application allows intuitive and
efficient manipulation of model parts,
meshes, vertices, UV coordinates,
and bone weights, simplifying
the modding and editing process.
